q: What is the carbon footprint of river sand or manufactured sand?
title: Sand carbon footprint per tonne
short: River sand's footprint is mostly diesel for excavators, pumps and trucks, so haul distance often matters most. Manufactured sand adds crushing and washing electricity. Ask suppliers for diesel and power per tonne, and add your own transport from pit or plant to site.
audience: Builders, RMC plants and sand suppliers

ul: Excavator or pump diesel per tonne.
Truck diesel from pit to yard and site.

senseible: Senseible reads bills, fuel invoices and production records into dated, fingerprinted records, so the figure you send a buyer can be traced to its documents.
